name: Salon B - Square Texts and Reminders (Telnyx)

parameters.content:
## B. Square Texts and Reminders

**In simple words:** watches the Square calendar and sends the right text.

**When a booking changes** (Square tells us right away):
- New booking: confirmation to the client (if they booked online) + heads-up to the stylist
- Cancelled: tells the stylist the time is open, and asks the client if they want another day
- No-show: asks the client if they want to reschedule, tells the manager (who can charge the fee in Square)

**Every hour:** 2 days before: reminder + "Reply C to confirm". 1 day before and still not confirmed: tells the manager. 2 hours before: reminder. After the visit: thank-you + review link.

**Turn off Square's own text reminders** so clients don't get two.
